root_cause.detail: All ten immutable members completed native re-entry and resurrection, but recovery evidence and the current-wipe ready check were still pending. Drudge route decisions resumed; both tanks then died again. Continuing would have produced repeated contaminated partial-death evidence, so the operator interrupted the diagnostic rehearsal.
root_cause.dps_assessment: All ten class/spec DB profiles were loaded with the expected common content hash. Effective damage was low because route movement, hazard, formation, future-encounter and recovery authority frequently returned after profile selection but before action execution. The fire mage selected valid actions yet recorded zero combat attempts. This is not evidence that dummy-trained tuning failed.
root_cause.cpu_and_volume_assessment: The worldserver used about 36 percent CPU and 1.56 GB RSS. The 32.6 MB log was dominated by full diagnose and trace payloads, while repeated native path checks and fail-closed Drudge formation were the likely runtime hot path.
remediation_scope: latch native recovery authority at the exact all-dead edge until current-wipe readycheck-backed evidence completes
keep owner, pet and controlled offense suppressed before any decision-timer or route return
reduce full diagnosis and trace cadence while preserving material-edge and final forced bundles
clean every native group containing an exact validation character before reprovisioning
separate profile selection, blocked-before-execute, submitted and landed counters
cache native pathability only with route, attempt, wipe, bot and anchor invalidation identity

acceptance.next_gate: Independent review, exact coordinated rebuild, clean reprovision/readback, and an uncapped Magmaw rerun with a Luna-xhigh babysitter.
